# Security reports

Report suspected vulnerabilities privately to security@mistyislesoftware.co.uk.
If GitHub displays a private vulnerability reporting option, you may use it.
Its availability is not guaranteed by this file.

Do not open a public issue with exploit details, credentials, bearer URLs,
plaintext, ciphertext or other sensitive user material. Provide a minimal
synthetic reproduction and coordinate disclosure privately.
Do not test against other people's data or disrupt a service.

Source availability does not imply that a public beta is operating or that a
particular snapshot is approved for deployment. Only accepted, signed publication
snapshots participate in the controlled release process.
